nodes.prompt: TASK: Implement the smallest coherent production fix that turns the verified terminal, pane-handle, and browser pane-edge RED tests GREEN in /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite. DELIVERABLE: edit only ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx, ui/src/components/tab-dnd/tabDragTypes.ts, and only if required ui/src/components/tab-dnd/PaneEdgeDropZones.tsx; preserve all current uncommitted work. Expand callback types locally to return detached tab id and accept targetPane. Do not alter the already-green reducer/store helpers, CSS tokens, tests, package files, or unrelated dirty files. Follow strict TypeScript; no any, assertions, ignores, non-null assertions, or swallowed catches. VERIFY: first run cd ui && bunx vitest run src/components/TerminalSplitView.paneDrop.runtime.test.tsx src/components/TerminalSplitView.paneHandleDrop.runtime.test.tsx src/components/TerminalSplitView.browserPaneDrop.runtime.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1 and require all 6 tests pass; then run the focused existing component/store regression suite: src/components/TerminalSplitView.test.tsx src/components/TerminalSplitView.tabDropFallback.test.tsx src/state/workspaceStore.tabDrop.test.tsx src/state/workspaceStore.paneDrop.runtime.test.tsx src/state/layout.paneHandleDrop.runtime.test.ts --maxWorkers=1. Report exact commands/output and changed lines. STOP WHEN: both commands exit 0 and only allowed production files changed.
